chapter: Philadelphia, New York and Sam Wooding in Europe
title: Touring Germany, Spain, Vienna and Constantinople
summary: Berlin was headquarters for long engagements across Germany, Spain, Vienna and Constantinople, with recordings made in Barcelona.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Now did you -- where else did you go in Europe. You went in Germany --
So we -- we went with the show, we went all over Germany, played Hamburg, and most of our engagements were sometimes a month --
-- to two months long. We were all
over the place, Leipzig, Dresden, Frankfurt, and hope I don't forget any -- I say Hamburg, Frankfurt, and then we went to Spain, --
Yes, we were in Madrid for almost a month or two. Then we went to the Moulin Rouge, then we went to the Florida, that's where -- Barcelona a long time there, about two, three months in Barcelona.
And you recorded while you were in Barcelona?
We recorded while we were in Barcelona.

Yes, that's where we made our recordings, in Vienna, we were at the Moulin Rouge in Vienna, went to Constantinople, back to Hamburg and we went down to San Sebastian, Spain, we were a long time getting to Paris, because he didn't -- they wanted the band in Paris, but he didn't want to take the band to Paris, because he was afraid he would lose musicians, there, because there was -- opportunities was very good in Paris at that time, and the money was very good. So he waited till he just couldn't help himself. Last minute to take the band to Paris, now that's what happened when he took the band to Paris. I left, Jerry Blake left.
